sub_site: whole blood (CRC cases, intestinal adenoma, colonoscopy controls)

evidence.quote: An aliquot of 0.25 ml of whole blood was used for DNA extraction.
MiSeq Illumina technology was applied to compute 16S rRNA gene taxonomic profiling.
The number of bacterial 16S rRNA gene copies per µl of blood was measured as the abundance of 16S rRNA by qPCR in triplicate

notes: 300 subjects (100 CRC, 100 IA, 100 controls); 4 excluded for low reads -> 296 profiled. Only aspirin-differential genera named (full table in S1 File, not converted). Vaiomer pipeline; no negative controls mentioned in this paper (may be in earlier cohort paper ref 14).
